text:
ana: Heads-up: Bellatrix-14b bring-up results are in from the headline slices. We ran three quant variants on the long-context QA + priming slice: int8 baseline, q6_k (int6), and q4_pchan (per-channel int4).

ravi: Nice. Top-line numbers? token-cost and quality 

ana: top-line: p@5 (QA long) = int8 0.682, int6 0.674, int4-pchan 0.668. Latency median: int8 280ms, int6 250ms, int4 235ms. 95th: int8 680ms, int6 720ms, int4 790ms. Cost per token (approx): int8 $0.00061, int6 $0.00048, int4 $0.00034. Sample size ~7.2k queries.

jules: So int4 wins cost but loses ~1.4% abs on p@5 vs int8; int6 is a middle ground ~0.8% drop and ~21% cheaper.

ravi: Did int4 use per-channel scales everywhere or selective?

ana: per-channel applied only to embedding + attention proj layers (we left MLPs global to keep perf). No outlier correction yet. Also we toggled prefix-KV cache on for all runs.

jules: Good call on selective pchan. From prior history that non-MLP pchan recovers most priming sensitivity with tiny perf hit.

pm: For product/GTN we need an explicit unit-econ table (cost per 1M tokens) and a short recommended routing plan if we suggest hybrid. Can you calc?

ana: quick calcs: 1M tokens => int8 ~$610, int6 ~$480, int4 ~$340. Relative to int8: int6 -21%, int4 -44%. Expected quality delta vs int8 (p@5): int6 -1.2% rel, int4 -2.0% rel (approx).

ravi: Two low-effort experiments before routing decision: 1) int4 + outlier-correction on the top 10% largest-activation blocks; 2) a 24h slice A/B: route priming_tokens > 450 to int6 vs int4. If outlier correction recovers >0.6% p@5, we can prefer int4-pchan+outlier.

jules: I can run the outlier-correct patch. Also propose a hybrid selector config for canary routing to share with GTN: 

```json
{
  "flag": "bellatrix_hybrid_priming",
  "selector": {"priming_tokens_gt": 450, "has_system_tag": true},
  "split": {"int6": 0.2, "int4": 0.8}
}
```

pm: For GTN we'll show expected cost/$1M and projected p@5 hit. Also include rollback thresholds if p@5 drops >0.8% on live.

infra-bot: infra: started microbench-outlier-int4 -> run 3291111200

ana: Action items: jules = run outlier-correction microbench and post results; ravi = author GTN short memo with unit econ table + rollback plan; ana = wire up the 24h A/B canary and monitor p@5/latency tails. Reconvene after results (ETA ~12h).

ravi: One more ask: include token-econ tail cost estimate (account for 95th latency SLOs) in the GTN note. int4's higher tail could increase infra cost due to slower throughput.

jules: noted, I'll capture kernel throughput diffs and add to run logs.

ana: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the canonical bring-up log for Bellatrix quant experiments.
